meaning: Two independent static analyzer scores. Categories are labels only; no category grades or combined total.

detekt.Compose.ModifierClickableOrder.rationale: Modifier order can change hit/visual bounds.

detekt.Compose.ModifierComposed.rationale: Legacy composed modifier adds composition overhead; actual cost unmeasured.

detekt.Compose.ModifierMissing.rationale: Caller cannot provide a standard layout/behavior modifier.

detekt.Compose.ModifierNotUsedAtRoot.rationale: Caller allocation can be applied to the wrong layout owner.

detekt.Compose.ModifierReused.rationale: Caller modifier contract can affect multiple children.

detekt.Compose.ModifierShouldBeForwarded.rationale: A branch drops caller layout behavior.

detekt.Compose.ModifierWithoutDefault.rationale: Caller must provide a normally optional layout argument.

detekt.Compose.ComposableNestingDepth.rationale: Project policy is not selected in this fixed profile.

detekt.Compose.ConditionHoist.rationale: Branch assembly duplicates decisions; correctness is not inferred.

detekt.Compose.ContentEmitterReturningVa.rationale: Mixes UI emission with returned values and ambiguous ownership.

detekt.Compose.ContentSlotReused.rationale: Slot reuse changes composition identity and retention expectations.

detekt.Compose.ContentTrailingLambda.rationale: Slot placement is a call-site convention.

detekt.Compose.DefaultsVisibility.rationale: Default visibility differs from the API visibility contract.

detekt.Compose.LambdaParameterEventTrail.rationale: Event/slot call-site ambiguity is a convention risk.

detekt.Compose.MultipleEmitters.rationale: Multiple root emitters complicate layout ownership; not inherently a crash.

detekt.Compose.ParameterNaming.rationale: Parameter naming convention, not semantic proof.

detekt.Compose.MutableParams.rationale: Unobservable mutable input can bypass expected UI invalidation.

detekt.Compose.MutableStateAutoboxing.rationale: Optional optimization hint without demonstrated behavioral failure.

detekt.Compose.MutableStateParam.rationale: Public writable state exposes write authority beyond the caller.

detekt.Compose.RememberContentMissing.rationale: Movable content identity is recreated during recomposition.

detekt.Compose.StaleRememberUpdatedState.rationale: Captured value can stop reflecting current input.

detekt.Compose.StateParam.rationale: State wrapper exposes observation policy in an API boundary.

detekt.Compose.VarsWithoutStateBacking.rationale: Mutable UI state lacks observable backing.

detekt.Compose.LambdaParameterInRestarta.rationale: Effect capture can retain an outdated callback.

detekt.Compose.CompositionLocalAllowlist.rationale: Project policy is not selected in this fixed profile.

detekt.Compose.Material2.rationale: Project policy is not selected in this fixed profile.

detekt.Compose.UnstableCollections.rationale: Project policy is not selected in this fixed profile.

detekt.Compose.ViewModelForwarding.rationale: Child depends on a broader owner than its state/event contract.

detekt.Compose.ViewModelInjection.rationale: Dependency acquisition is hidden in a UI contract.

detekt.Compose.PreviewNaming.rationale: Project policy is not selected in this fixed profile.

detekt.Compose.InvalidReadOnlyComposable.rationale: Read-only annotation claims a stronger contract than the implementation.

detekt.Compose.MissingNonRestartableComp.rationale: Optional optimization hint without demonstrated behavioral failure.

detekt.Compose.MissingReadOnlyComposable.rationale: Optional optimization hint without demonstrated behavioral failure.

detekt.Compose.UnnecessaryComposable.rationale: Optional optimization hint without demonstrated behavioral failure.

detekt.complexity.CyclomaticComplexMetho.rationale: Branch complexity exceeds the frozen maintainability threshold.

detekt.complexity.LongMethod.rationale: Method length exceeds the frozen structure threshold.

detekt.complexity.NestedBlockDepth.rationale: Nesting exceeds the frozen readability threshold.

detekt.complexity.TooManyFunctions.rationale: Function count in the reported file/class/interface/object/enum exceeds its frozen maintainability threshold.

detekt.complexity.LongParameterList.rationale: Required argument count exceeds the frozen API threshold.

detekt.empty-blocks.EmptyCatchBlock.rationale: Caught failures disappear without handling or propagation.

detekt.Composer.UntypedEventCallback.rationale: Any payload removes compile-time event shape constraints.

detekt.Composer.NondeterministicDefault.rationale: Omitted argument changes on reevaluation instead of explicit input lifetime.

detekt.Composer.NoOpActionDefault.rationale: Required-looking action can silently do nothing.

detekt.Composer.PositionalBooleanArgumen.rationale: Multiple supplied Boolean arguments without names obscure call-site roles; one defect per call.
detekt.Composer.PositionalBooleanArgumen.counting_unit: resolved-source-callable-contract; unresolved identity remains per diagnostic

detekt.Composer.RedundantSizeModifier.rationale: Identical consecutive constant allocation is redundant.

detekt.Composer.BlockingCallInCompositio.rationale: Synchronous blocking or IO is performed during composition.

detekt.Composer.NondeterministicPreview.rationale: Fixture cannot be reproduced from fixed inputs.

detekt.Composer.PreviewEnvironmentDepend.rationale: Fixture depends on external runtime environment.

detekt.style.UnusedPrivateFunction.rationale: Dead private implementation increases maintenance noise.

detekt.Composer.UnusedEventCallback.rationale: Declared event is never consumed by the implementation.

detekt.Composer.UnusedUiParameter.rationale: Declared UI data is never consumed by the implementation.

detekt.Composer.StateWriteInComposition.rationale: Composition directly writes snapshot state, risking feedback/repeated mutation.

detekt.Composer.CoroutineLaunchInComposi.rationale: Composition directly starts asynchronous work without effect/event lifetime.

detekt.Composer.InvalidLayoutBounds.rationale: Constant padding or min/max violates the declared layout bounds.

detekt.Composer.ConstantLazyItemKey.rationale: A constant key duplicates identity for multi-item workloads.

detekt.Composer.UnkeyedRememberCapture.rationale: Direct parameter capture retains its first value without an invalidation key.

detekt.Composer.DroppedEventCallback.rationale: Resolved forwarding reaches a concrete source helper that never consumes the input, within the configured trace depth.

detekt.Composer.DroppedUiInput.rationale: Resolved forwarding reaches a concrete source helper that never consumes the input, within the configured trace depth.

detekt.Composer.WhitespaceLayoutSpacer.rationale: Whitespace-only Text couples spacing to glyph metrics rather than a layout allocation.

detekt.Composer.PreviewDuplicateBody.rationale: Existing Preview duplicates a nontrivial production body instead of delegating.

high.meaning: Direct mutation/lifetime/blocking risk in composition; not a measured crash claim.

major.meaning: Lost contract, stale state, layout bounds or identity risk.

moderate.meaning: Dependency, API or maintainability risk with narrower immediate consequences.

minor.meaning: Naming, ordering, visibility or local redundancy convention.

advisory.meaning: Optimization hint; no demonstrated behavioral defect.
